name: Antisocial Personality Disorder

name: Avoidant Personality Disorder
key_features: views self as inept or inferior
differentials: Personality Change Due to Another Medical Condition
min_duration: Enduring; begins by early adulthood (if <18 y, ≥1 yr)
age_notes: Childhood shyness common precursor but usually dissipates; use great caution in children/adolescents; prevalence >65 y ~0.8%

name: Borderline Personality Disorder
differentials: Personality Change Due to Another Medical Condition
min_duration: Enduring; begins by early adulthood (if <18 y, ≥1 yr)

name: Dependent Personality Disorder
key_features: excessive need to be taken care of

differentials: Personality Change Due to Another Medical Condition

name: General Personality Disorder

differentials: Personality Change Due to Another Medical Condition
min_duration: Long-standing; onset traceable to at least adolescence/early adulthood; if <18 y, features present ≥1 year

name: Histrionic Personality Disorder
key_features: uncomfortable when not center of attention
differentials: Personality Change Due to Another Medical Condition
min_duration: Enduring; begins by early adulthood (if <18 y, ≥1 yr)
age_notes: Norms for emotional expression vary by age group; consider age before labeling

name: Narcissistic Personality Disorder
min_duration: Enduring; begins by early adulthood (if <18 y, ≥1 yr)
age_notes: Narcissistic traits common in adolescents and do not necessarily predict adult NPD; aging limitations can be hard to adjust to

name: Obsessive-Compulsive Personality Disorder
differentials: Personality Change Due to Another Medical Condition
min_duration: Enduring; begins by early adulthood (if <18 y, ≥1 yr)
